operation.body:
## Goal
Record the owner's R-001 A/Y approval in project documentation and deliver the first working Swift CLI increment: a reusable versioned discovery report core and an explicitly synthetic demo command. This is the first scaffold-producing substep of approved public-telemetry-first slice A, not completion of slice A or phase 1.

## Acceptance criteria
- Synchronize requirements, decisions, specification and directly affected context with the explicit R-001 approval recorded at https://github.com/szymoniwacz/mac-thermal-control/issues/1#issuecomment-6879220276, retaining all safety gates and low-risk-only conditional auto-merge.
- Add a real SwiftPM executable and reusable report core, using Swift 5.7-compatible syntax and an explicit macOS 12 deployment target, with no third-party dependencies.
- Provide a clearly labeled synthetic demo CLI emitting schema-version-1 JSON inventory or JSONL session records to stdout. Default/live invocation must refuse collection; there must be no hardware/native telemetry, SMC, subprocess collector, network, privilege, persistence or workload path.
- Implement typed observations/statuses, explicit null values for unavailable data, source provenance, complete capability gaps, deterministic fixture timing, bounded configuration validation and CPU-tick delta/reset handling with meaningful unit and CLI tests. Reject invalid/nonfinite configuration and serialization values; distinguish actual zero from unavailable data.
- Record actual build/run/test/typecheck/lint applicability and observed compiler/SDK evidence. Add macOS product CI (fixture-only) while preserving both existing adapter jobs and security/leak coverage. No hardware tests in local validation or CI.
- Complete applicable validation, integrated and self-correcting review, signed commit/PR handoff and remote CI. Auto-merge only if independently assessed Low risk and otherwise eligible; escalate Medium/High or mandatory-review changes.

## Constraints
Parent: https://github.com/szymoniwacz/mac-thermal-control/issues/1. The owner explicitly requested local Project Executor continuation with self-correcting-review and conditional low-risk auto-merge. Only one delegated goal. R-001 approves staged sequencing and contract, not hardware tests or compatibility. No privileged operation, SMC write, hardware test or workload is authorized. Build/tests and CLI checks must use synthetic fixtures only. Preserve private workflow, historical reference, unrelated .gitlab/ files and existing CI jobs. Risk: demo mistaken for live evidence, accidental hardware source execution in tests, invalid JSON/state semantics, newest CI hiding Swift 5.7 compatibility. Decision queue: no new material design decision required for this bounded contract substep; exact live calls, native isolation, secure local report persistence, deadlines and real capture are later implementation work within approved contract. No claim those are implemented here.

## Out of scope
Live inventory or telemetry, driver/native calls, AppleSMC, fan/sensor access, privileged helper, child-process collectors, filesystem report persistence, sampling scheduler/deadline enforcement, hardware compatibility certification, controlled workloads, GUI/control/recovery, dependency/toolchain installation, background automation or a second goal.

## Relevant context
R-001 contract: docs/discovery-specification.md at d46c3172329914ec6158c1050adf5d8542bcecd9; .ai/docs/project-requirements.md; .ai/docs/architecture-direction.md; .ai/project/; .ai/quality/definition-of-ready.md. Bootstrap PR #8 and contract PR #10 are merged; main CI run 43578155695 passed. Local compiler metadata: Apple Swift 5.7.2, x86_64-apple-darwin21.6.0, SDK 13.1; compiler metadata is not a hardware test or target-device certification.
